title: Pisces | Zodiac Constellation | 30 Minute Breathing Meditation | Slow Breath, 7 Stages | Biovagal
desc:
Pisces constellation | 30-minute breathing meditation
Biovagal: sound, breath and stillness.

WHAT YOU ARE SEEING: The Pisces constellation (the two fishes) lighting up star by star, with its bright star Alrescha marked. Your breathing circle is on screen. Breathe with the circle: in through the nose, out through the mouth, 5 seconds each way, or whichever feels comfortable.
WHAT IT IS FOR: 30 minutes of slow breathing under one calm night-sky shape to focus on.
WHO IT IS FOR: Pisces season people (19 Feb - 20 Mar), stargazers, and anyone who likes astrology symbolism or settles better with one thing to look at. Are you a Pisces? Say hello in the comments.

Over seven stages, about four minutes each, the sign appears: the dark sky, the first stars, the line forms, the shape, the bright star, the whole sign, and stillness. A soft bowl sounds every 20 seconds. In the last two minutes the bowls sound together.
In traditional astrology Pisces is associated with imagination, empathy and dreaming. That is traditional symbolism, not science, and this video makes no claims about personality, luck, relationships, health or effects. Intention: to sit quietly for 30 minutes and breathe slowly. The star map is a simplified outline, not to scale.
Breathe slowly and comfortably. Never hold your breath or breathe fast. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
The bowls are synthesised, not recordings. Headphones required (a soft binaural tone sits under the bowls: Theta binaural beats, 6 Hz). No hidden audio. Visible text only.

Chapters:
0:00 The dark sky
4:00 First stars
8:00 The line forms
12:00 The shape
16:00 The bright star
20:00 The whole sign
24:00 Stillness
28:00 Closing bowls

Traditional associations and personal intentions. For relaxation only. Not medical advice. Do not use while driving.
Suggested practice: 30 minutes a day for 3 weeks.
